message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Coding Style

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
    dresscode:
        name: DressCode
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v7
            - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
              with:
                  php-version: 8.4
                  coverage: none

            - name: Cache composer dependencies
              uses: actions/cache@v4
              with:
                path: ~/.composer/cache/files
                key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
                restore-keys: |
                  ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

            - run: composer install --no-progress --prefer-dist
            - run: composer create-project dresscode/dresscode temp/dresscode ^1.1 --no-progress
            - run: php temp/dresscode/bin/dresscode check


    nette_cc:
        name: Nette Code Checker
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v7
            - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
              with:
                  php-version: 8.4
                  coverage: none

            - name: Cache composer dependencies
              uses: actions/cache@v4
              with:
                path: ~/.composer/cache/files
                key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
                restore-keys: |
                  ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

            - run: composer create-project nette/code-checker temp/code-checker ^3 --no-progress
            - run: php temp/code-checker/code-checker --strict-types --no-progress --ignore "tests/*/fixtures"",
  "rationale": "Both jobs repeatedly fetch Composer dependencies on every push and pull_request run. Adding actions/cache for the Composer download cache (keyed on composer.lock with a restore fallback) preserves all existing check steps and coverage while reducing repeated dependency fetch time. This matches the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency_cache pattern: repeated dependency fetching is measurable, cache inputs include the lockfile, no equivalent cache exists, and cached Composer packages are trusted declared dependencies rather than mutable build outputs. No permissions are weakened and no new network access, secrets, or deployment steps are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
